Lifecycle Phase 07 of 10

Deployment Support

Controlled release to the production environment.

Overview

The Deployment Support phase governs the controlled release of the solution to the production environment. Hardened Builds LLC plans and executes deployment through established, repeatable procedures, with defined rollback provisions and verification of the released system.

Activities and Deliverables

  • A documented release and deployment plan.
  • Controlled execution of the deployment through established procedures.
  • Defined and tested rollback procedures to address release failure.
  • Verification that the deployed system operates as intended.
  • Coordination with stakeholders throughout the release window.

Phase Specifics

  • Documented release planning
  • Controlled deployment execution
  • Defined rollback procedures
  • Post-release verification

Engagement

This phase is available as part of a complete lifecycle engagement or as a discrete service.
